### A Forgotten Hero
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-june-17-2024.html
Passage: Acts 9:20-21
Points:
- Saul experienced a stunning transformation, immediately proclaiming Jesus as the Son of God in the synagogues.
- The Damascus crowds were left in ecstatic astonishment, knowing he had come to arrest believers.
- Saul steadily grew stronger, skillfully weaving Old Testament scriptures together to prove Jesus is the Messiah.
- This world-changing ministry was sparked by the quiet, courageous obedience of Ananias.

### Day 236: Acts 9:10–22
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-236-acts-9-1022.html
Passage: Acts 9:21
Points:
- Saul's new birth ignited an unstoppable spiritual light that completely flipped his life purpose.
- Listeners were astonished to hear a notorious persecutor now boldly proclaiming the very name he tried to destroy.
- The Holy Spirit granted Saul supernatural spiritual power that far exceeded his physical stature.
- Saul confounded his opponents by systematically knitting Old Testament promises to their fulfillment in Jesus.
- Facing mockery and death plots, Saul persevered not as a captor of believers, but as a willing prisoner of Christ.
